question: Where is hotel located inside a 170 kilometers radius on the way from USS Serpens Monument, VA to Lillie Carroll Jackson Civil Rights Museum, Baltimore, MD?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.06869 38.874024)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.627017 39.304312)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.06869 38.874024)',4326)::geography, 170000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.06869 38.874024)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
